per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must respond to small operations, such as opening a student profile or updating a status, within a few seconds.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must generate a full schedule within half a minute to prevent users from getting distracted and reverting to manual workarounds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system must be available during business hours (8 AM to 6 PM on weekdays) to support scheduling activities.
